messages:
Maria: heads-up — after the routing weight tweak this morning I'm seeing huge main-thread spikes when opening dashboards with many series. legend rendering seems to trigger a relayout loop.
Sam: can you dump a profile or a HAR? rough numbers?
Maria: screenshot + perf trace attached in thread (sorry large). flame shows repeated GC + style recalcs tied to legend paint. average FCP fine but long tail for interactive.
Chris: hmm, is this the canary that changed prefetch priority? I thought that only affected network.
Maria: it's the canary that also toggled the new lazy-sourcemap parsing flag. not 1:1 proof but timeline lines up.
Lee: do we have metric deltas? tokenwise / bundle size changed?
Maria: bundle gz +60kb; parsed bytes +120kb on first load. Telemetry shows +30ms parse on first paint.
Sam: interesting — a small parse bump can amplify if it defers worker creation and we fallback to main thread. do we have worker fallback logs?
Maria: yes, see logs: "worker-init-timeout => main-thread-parse" in console.
Chris: that message means the worker didn't start within 200ms and we decode inline. can we increase worker timeout or prioritize worker spawn?
Sam: config wise the canary reduced worker concurrency to avoid GPU pressure. that could starve worker threads.
Lee: also noticed KV-prefetch heatmap keys had more misses after routing policy change; prefix cache miss causes extra syncs during render. could be compounding.
Maria: agreed — two things: sourcemap lazy parse fallback and kv-prefetch miss -> synchronous style reads. both expensive.
Sam: quick experiment suggestion: rollback the lazy-sourcemap flag in canary and bump worker timeout to 500ms. if latency drops we isolate sourcemap.
Chris: +1. also add a short-term guard: if legend node count > 50 skip SVG-heavy operations and use a compact renderer. cheap mitigation.
Maria: I can try the guard locally and open a canary build.
deploy-bot: canary deploy starting: canary-id=canary-2026-03-21-09-12, nodes=2
Maria: deployed compact-legend guard to canary. initial load looks ~40% better on the heavy dashboard.
Sam: roll back lazy-sourcemap on canary now so we test isolation?
Chris: rolled back flag in canary. observing metrics.
Lee: telemetry shows main-thread time dropping ~35ms on the heavy route. KV miss rate unchanged though.
Maria: so sourcemap parse fallback was the big tail. kv misses still need follow-up but not SLO-critical.
Sam: action items: 1) Chris to investigate worker start heuristics + raise timeout (owner: Chris) 2) Platform to evaluate routing policy that caused KV-prefetch miss (owner: Sam) 3) Maria to open follow-up PR for compact-legend renderer and tests (owner: Maria)
Chris: noted. I'll also instrument worker-init latency to prometheus.
Lee: I'll create an alert for legend-render main-thread tail > 200ms so we catch regressions.
Maria: thanks all — will promote compact-legend to prod once green in canary. :thumbsup:
Sam: nice triage. tagging @eng-sre for observability ticket.
Maria: closing thread once PRs land.
_meta: generated for dataset; single slack thread representing root + replies
